title: Syrian Biryani Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and aromatic one-pot dish made with basmati rice, meat, and spices. This recipe serves as a base for a quick and delicious Syrian-inspired meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cumin, cayenne pepper, turmeric, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the meat and spice mixture.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the biryani with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
